q1k4tcrdhaqesonjgidc.webp.story: Designed and built by Team Matrix for Techfest IIT Bombay 2024, our Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) is a testament to cutting-edge engineering and aquatic robotics. Equipped with a color-based navigation system, it glides through underwater environments with precision. Featuring a robust waterproof design, three vertical thrusters for depth control, and two horizontal thrusters for seamless movement, our AUV excels in maneuverability. With an integrated dropping mechanism for precise deployments, it’s built to tackle real-world underwater challenges efficiently!
